s05066.summary: Exhausted coworkers agree not to provoke Greg and bicker about Bex's tastes.
Greg's text announces another breakout and Bex schemes to avoid presenting.
Group chat warns Greg is coming, and he steps off the elevator crying.
Greg sniffles praise and enters the suite, leaving the team frozen outside.

s05109.summary: Mo cooks eggs in his drizzly food truck as commuters queue.
An automated call tells Mo his health inspection arrives in two minutes.
Mo hides dodgy food as the inspector approaches and the queue scatters.

s05060.summary: A guarded woman with a duffel gets into exhausted Mo's late-night rideshare.
Mo studies her in the mirror and recognizes someone rehearsing something hard.
She shuts down Mo's small talk, insisting she paid for a ride only.
She asks Mo to make the trip longer, and he takes the river road.
Mo mentions his daughter, admitting she only mostly calls on Sundays.
Ignoring her brother's calls, she admits she's returning to her estranged mother.
Learning her mother always leaves the porch light on, she breaks down crying.
She reveals her real name is Tamsin, and they share a small joke.
Mo promises she can sit in the car as long as she needs.
They park by the lit house; Tamsin freezes until a curtain moves upstairs.
Shaking, Tamsin gets out, asks Mo to wait, and thanks him.
Her mother opens the door, and Mo looks away and switches off the radio.

s05126.summary: On a heritage sailing smack, Jen scolds Mo's rope work while a stranger watches.
Sal warns the woman the boom is coming round, but she refuses to move.
The boom swings and Jen dives, dragging the woman clear just in time.
Shaken, Jen and Sal question the woman, who gives her name as Ro.
Big Dave's harbour patrol launch emerges from the fog for a permit check.
Big Dave reveals Ro's mother is searching; Ro explains she wanted to see her roots.
Mo finally ties the rope correctly as rain begins.

s05012.summary: Lucy, Big Mo and robot Zip run the taco truck under three moons.
Grandma Tess calls by hologram, fussing over Lucy and scolding Mo.

s05177.summary: Night-shift nurses joke about Orrin's messages about a glowing thing in room six.
Dr. Nakamura reports a patient in room six who isn't on the board.
A barefoot, faintly glowing woman appears at the desk asking where others wait.
Elspeth says she was admitted four hundred years ago, and everything stops.

s05163.summary: Online friends Philippa and Thaddeus meet in person at a reenactment camp.
Wick joins by video from work, flustered about their manager and mute.
Over a fake-period Costco biscuit, the three friends tease each other and laugh.

s05105.summary: Dr. Haq checks Dana is fine being filmed; she says Wes disapproves.
Wes texts from the parking lot, so Dana puts him on speaker.
Dr. Haq says the third cycle failed; Dana insists brittle that it's fine.
Haq gently offers a costly fourth option, and Wes calls it pushing.
Fed up with Wes counting costs, Dana hangs up on him.
Dana addresses the camera and agrees to discuss the fourth option; Wes is coming.

s05129.summary: In a Chicago nail salon, a poised woman compliments Marisol's steady hands.
Talk of boxing leads Marisol to mention Danny Kessler, and the woman stiffens.
Marisol recounts the fixed fight that ruined her father and the boss behind it.
Two men enter; Marisol says she has every receipt as proof.
Marisol names herself Kessler's daughter and names the woman as Corinne Vale.
Corinne realizes the men at the door belong to Marisol.
Corinne ignores her buzzing phone as the boxing crowd roars on TV.

s05180.summary: Ruiz narrates as soldiers sweep a vet clinic hunting a deserter.
Ruiz demands Hale's location; Okafor explains he treated Hale and his dog.
Ruiz accuses Okafor of harboring a killer; Okafor defends his duty to patients.
Okafor reveals Hale kept repeating Ruiz's own name under anesthesia.
Movement in surgery; Ruiz holds the squad back and admits Hale runs from her.
They storm surgery to find Hale gone and the dog waiting for Ruiz.
Contact at the front entrance as the lights die in the clinic.

s05068_0.summary: A nervous man enters the parole office clutching a folder and waits.
The man avoids giving Deb his name until she tells him to sit.

s05150_0.summary: A soaked woman with bolt cutters walks the rainy storage facility corridor.
She ignores Nell's worried texts as the lights flicker overhead.

s05171_1.summary: Bea tells Rena not to look at the camera as the crowd chants outside.

s05064_0.summary: Nate vlogs his entry into an abandoned vet clinic and its creepy lore.
The camera pushes toward a dark hallway behind a rusted gurney.
Mo texts begging him to come home, and Nate brushes him off.
The camera catches something pale passing outside as Nate heads for the hallway.

s05150_3.summary: Priya finally answers Nell, flatly telling her she found everything.
Priya tells Toby to leave the hall light off as rain drips.

s05064_2.summary: Nate sprints from the creature but finds the front door locked from outside.
Nate begs teenagers filming outside to open the door; one just waves.
The pale creature rises behind Nate; the camera falls as he is dragged away.

s05144.summary: In a crowded parole waiting room, Jen orders everyone to sign in.
Big Dave protests a new parole condition despite eleven months of compliance.
Dave drags Mo in over a promised letter; Mo dodges.
Jen clears the room so they can talk.
Dave demands to know who reported him; Jen refuses to say.
Dave lunges and they crash into the water cooler.
Mo admits she made the call, and Dave sinks into his chair.

s05093.summary: Mo coaxes take after take of Linus's earnest song about ham.
Label boss Denise demands the single; Mo claims it's still ripening.
Mo calls a huddle and jokes about Linus's emotionally honest ham.
Wren threatens to quit, Denise overhears, and take forty-three begins.

s05111_1.summary: They tumble into the rain as the studio windows blow out.
Riley gets a text saying take twelve and drops his phone in a puddle.

s05174.summary: Jen confronts Mo for seating Big Dave next to his ex.
A door slams outside; they both assume it's Dave.
Jen softens and tells Mo it was the best wedding in years.
Mo ignores an HR text and they stay together for the last song.

s05058.summary: On a quiet trawler, Anika jinxes the trip and Roy warns her off.
A loose net slams into Teo, pinning him on the deck.
Anika assesses Teo's injuries and directs Roy to hold his head steady.
Anika promises Teo he'll live despite Roy's doubt as they board him.

s05118_0.summary: Aiden, Sasha and Marlon break into a dark vet clinic.
A squeaky toy wakes a beagle, which yawns and ignores them.
Aiden explains the safe holds a ring Okafor lies about; they bicker over motives.
They creep to the office while Marlon guards the door.

s05150_2.summary: She finds photos of herself as a child with eyes scratched out.
Lights go out as teenage Toby appears offering to help carry.
She turns to see the mirror now facing the room, untouched.

s05027.summary: Kiki films a dance at the fountain while bickering with Kai and Jada.
An unknown text says stop filming; Kiki laughs it off as a bot.
A stranger steps into frame and cites her morning post about the fountain.
Another text warns her to walk away; they panic over who sent it.
Marcus admits he sent the texts and orders Kai to drop the phone.
A black van screeches up and Marcus orders all three inside.

s05036.summary: A neat stranger questions Skipper Brodie about the catch on his trawler.
The stranger lays out the smuggling timeline; Brodie asks who he is.
He reveals a badge: Detective Marcus Hale of the Maritime Task Force.
Searchlights sweep the water as Hale orders units to board.
Brodie realizes the betrayal; Hale quips about his chowder as the lamp shatters.

s05150_1.summary: She reaches Unit 214 and night manager Odell speaks over the intercom.
She cuts the padlock and raises the door to cold air.

s05181.summary: Marisol pushes her cart through a stormy Victorian hospital, ignoring a text.
Dr. Teague arrives early, trading barbs with Marisol as thunder rolls.
Bram reports a patient vanished through an open window.
Juno calls, warning Marisol to slowly walk away from Teague.
The lights die and Marisol steps between Teague and Bram.

s05088.summary: At the afterparty, Nora secretly points out a man at the bar to Callum.
Devon joins cheerfully; Nora covers her nerves with forced brightness.
Marin sends Devon away and pointedly asks Callum to watch Nora.
Callum asks about her clutch; Nora refuses to say here.

s05056.summary: A woman presses Hollis about a brand book, but his trunk is empty.
Wade calls warning Hollis not to open anything, asking who's there.
The woman gives her name as Odalys; Wade coldly says he's coming.
Odalys says she has waited thirty years, ten minutes more is nothing.

s05081.summary: Vesper and Okafor work on a padlock while Del keeps watch.
Del hears movement and orders the light killed; they freeze in darkness.
A door shuts softly far down the hall.

s05148_0.summary: Maya and Dev wait silently in a storm-darkened fertility clinic.
The nurse calls only Maya in, leaving Dev behind.
Alone, Dev texts his mom for advice and stares at a dying fish.
A soaked woman says she's here for the freezer and Dev follows her.
